newsitem.title: USA: HSBC Americas Q2 net rises to $116.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Americas Q2 net rises to $116.1 mln.

text.p: HSBC Americas Inc said Tuesday its net income for the second quarter was US$116.1 million compared with $89.1 million for the same period a year ago.
For the six month period, net income was $231 million compared with $175 million. Return on equity was 23.3 percent compared with 20.7 percent.
Assets increased by 45 percent to US$32.9 billion from US$22.7 billion at June 30, 1996.
The company said increased earnings were driven primarily by higher revenues, which were strongly enhanced by acquisitions.

The catalyst for the rise of US$10.2 billion in assets was its Marine Midland Bank unit's acquisition of the US$7.1 billion First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Rochester in the first quarter 1997.
HSBC Americas Inc is an indirectly held, wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings Plc.
